{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders
completed_mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Also compute the count of completed orders
n_completed = len(completed_orders)

# Compute the number of non-numeric (NaN) revenue entries in completed orders
n_na_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].isna().sum()

# Print all required values
print(f"Mean revenue: {completed_mean_revenue}")
print(f"Number of completed orders: {n_completed}")
print(f"Number of NaN revenue entries in completed orders: {n_na_revenue}")"}
